description: List WeCom departments and members (userid, name, department) visible to the app — the user ids send_wecom_message needs. Newer self-built apps often have NO contacts read permission (48002/60011); then the answer says so and falls back to the bare member id list where WeCom allows it. Optional department_id (default 1 = whole company), fetch_child (default true), limit.

department_id.description: Department to list, default 1 (the whole company).

name: list_wecom_contacts
